title: The Desire of Ages
description: Ellen G. White's masterwork on the life, ministry, sacrifice, and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

title: The Great Controversy
description: Traces the conflict between Christ and Satan from the destruction of Jerusalem, through the Reformation, down to the close of earth's history and the New Earth.

title: Patriarchs and Prophets
description: Covers the history of the world from the rebellion in heaven and Creation through the reign of King David.

title: Prophets and Kings
description: Begins with the glorious reign of King Solomon, through the divided monarchy and captivity, down to the restoration and the first advent of the Messiah.

title: The Acts of the Apostles
description: Chronicles the labors, trials, and triumphs of the early Christian apostles and the spread of the Gospel throughout the Roman Empire.

title: Steps to Christ
description: Her classic handbook on finding peace with God, true repentance, faith, prayer, and walking with Jesus.

title: Christ's Object Lessons
description: An exhaustive spiritual and practical commentary on the parables of Jesus.

title: Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing
description: Spiritual study on the Beatitudes, the Lord's Prayer, and Christ's Sermon on the Mount.

title: The Ministry of Healing
description: Practical counsel on holistic health, true remedies, sympathetic ministry, and the healing ministry of Christ.

title: Education
description: Sets forth the true objective of education: the harmonious development of the physical, mental, and spiritual powers.

title: Early Writings
description: A compilation of her earliest published works including Christian Experience and Views (1851) and Spiritual Gifts.

title: Gospel Workers
description: Exhaustive manual and counsel for ministers, evangelists, Bible workers, and all who preach the Word.

title: Counsels to Parents, Teachers, and Students
description: Guidance on Christian education in the home, church school, academies, and higher colleges.

title: Counsels on Health
description: Instruction regarding health reform, sanitariums, diet, hygiene, and the right arm of the message.

title: Testimonies to Ministers and Gospel Workers
description: Crucial messages sent to leadership and ministers from 1890 through 1914 regarding righteousness by faith and church administration.

title: Fundamentals of Christian Education
description: Chronological collection of 80 articles and messages on Christian education spanning from 1872 to 1915.

title: Christian Service
description: Handbook of instruction for lay members and church officers on organizing personal and public soul-winning.

title: Life Sketches of Ellen G. White
description: Autobiographical and biographical account of her life, travels, and ministry from childhood to her death in 1915.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 1
description: Letters and general testimonies given during the founding years of the Seventh-day Adventist movement.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 2
description: Counsel on personal piety, marriage, family order, health reform, and publishing work.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 3
description: Guidance on camp meetings, church discipline, and establishing institutions.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 4
description: Messages on spiritual decline, devotion, consecration, and worldwide expansion.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 5
description: Covers the critical era surrounding the 1888 Minneapolis conference and warnings against worldly conformity.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 6
description: Instructions on city evangelism, camp meetings, church schools, and publishing houses.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 7
description: Counsel regarding publishing work and sanitariums following the Battle Creek fires.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 8
description: Addressed to meeting the pantheistic crisis (the Kellogg crisis) and standing firm on foundational truths.

title: Testimonies for the Church, Volume 9
description: Final testimonies volume prepared by Ellen White, focusing on closing events, literature work, and the final crisis.

title: The Spirit of Prophecy, Volume 1
description: The great controversy from the fall of Satan and Creation down to Solomon.

title: The Spirit of Prophecy, Volume 2
description: The life, miracles, teachings, and ministry of Jesus Christ.

title: The Spirit of Prophecy, Volume 3
description: From Christ's transfiguration, trials, and death to the resurrection and labors of the apostles.

title: The Spirit of Prophecy, Volume 4
description: The 1884 classic presentation of the Great Controversy from Jerusalem's destruction to the New Earth.

title: Spiritual Gifts, Volume 1
description: The original 1858 vision of the great controversy between Christ and His angels and Satan and his angels.

title: Spiritual Gifts, Volume 2
description: My Christian Experience, Views and Labors in Connection With the Rise and Progress of the Third Angel's Message.

title: Spiritual Gifts, Volume 3
description: Important facts of faith in connection with the history of holy men of old.

title: Spiritual Gifts, Volume 4
category: Laws of Health & Old Testament History
description: Continuation of Old Testament narrative with teachings on health laws.

title: Christian Education
description: Early compilation on developing mind and character in Christian schools.

title: Christian Temperance and Bible Hygiene
description: Original compilation of articles on physical and spiritual health prepared with James White.

title: Manual for Canvassers
description: Instructions and spiritual encouragement for colporteurs and literature evangelists.

title: A Word to the Little Flock
description: Her first published visions and writings, co-published with James White and Joseph Bates.
